pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing items are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults view to open and filters done = 0 ORDER BY id; 'AC-2' tests / and /?view=open.
'AC-3' marks 3 and 1 done and expects '✓ First item', '✓ Third item' in id order.
'AC-4' expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for the default; the current view is a <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; Object.hasOwn guards the lookup.
'AC-7' and the Nothing open / Nothing done states check the messages, including 'No items yet.' in every view for an empty table.

traffic/routes.json lists both views, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in the last commit (e57728f 'Follow-up edits'). No remaining test checks routes.json, and the spec has no 'verified by review' step for it. test/traffic.test.js doesn't read routes.json. The item has no test.

findings.what: Commit e57728f ('Follow-up edits', by github-actions[bot]) deleted the 'AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views' test. AC-8 is now named by no test and the spec doesn't mark it 'verified by review'. If the routes were removed from traffic/routes.json, nothing would fail. The deletion is not explained in the PR and has no spec justification.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test, or replace it with one that reads traffic/routes.json (for example with node:fs, since the JSON import may be why it was dropped) and asserts it contains '/?view=done' and '/?view=all'.

findings.what: The PR says 'test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8' and 'Tests deleted or loosened: none'. Both are false: the AC-8 test was deleted in the final commit.
findings.fix: Restore the test and keep the PR claims; otherwise correct the PR body.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing '});' of the first describe block (line 73).

lenses.note: A spec exists with a go and decisions. The code follows both decisions: it opens on open items and uses a query parameter.
Seven of the eight acceptance items are met and tested. AC-8's test was deleted in the last commit, so AC-8 is unmet. Every row of the states table has a test.
I did not run the suite. The other tests assert behaviour and would fail on wrong code. The AC-8 test was deleted, and the PR's 'none deleted' claim is wrong.
View whitelist via Object.hasOwn, parameterised queries, escaped titles. The only issue is the stray blank line in the test file.
The view value is whitelisted and never interpolated from input; titles are HTML-escaped. The relaxed route regex in scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs still refuses spaces and #.
The diff has no UI files beyond server-rendered HTML in src/index.js, with no stylesheet or component files; nothing to assess visually.
No browser or UI flow is available; the page is covered by the response-level tests.
The title is within 72 characters. The claims 'covers AC-1 to AC-8' and 'Tests deleted: none' are false given commit e57728f.
